products.areas: S of Ocracoke Inlet NC to Cape Lookout NC out to 20 NM; S of Cape Lookout NC to Surf City NC out to 20 NM
products.description:
* WHAT...For the Small Craft Advisory, west winds 20 to 30 kt
and seas 6 to 9 ft. For the Gale Watch, southwest winds 25 to 35
kt with gusts up to 45 kt and seas 6 to 11 ft possible.

* WHERE...The coastal waters from Ocracoke Inlet to Surf City.

* WHEN...For the Small Craft Advisory, until 1 PM EST this
afternoon. For the Gale Watch, from late Sunday night through
Monday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds can cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Some infrequent gale force gusts (34kt)
will be possible over outer portions of these waters for a few
more hours.
products.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 28 at 12:05AM EST until November 28 at 1:00PM EST by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
products.instruction:
Mariners should consider altering plans to avoid possible
hazardous conditions.  Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter
course, and/or secure the vessel for severe wind and seas.
